tools.name: next_match
tools.description: A Premier League club's next match in any competition (Premier League, FA Cup, Carabao Cup, Champions League, Europa League, Conference League): opponent, competition, kick-off in UTC and UK time (plus a local time if you give a time zone), ground and the confirmed UK TV channel. tools.name: fixtures
tools.description: A Premier League club's upcoming games, in date order, with kick-off times, grounds and UK TV where confirmed. Filter by competition if asked ("Chelsea's Champions League fixtures"). Default 5 games, at most 20.

tools.name: results
tools.description: A Premier League club's latest results this season, newest first, in any competition: score, win/draw/loss, extra time and penalty shoot-outs. Default 5, at most 20. Use this for "how did Spurs get on?" or "Newcastle's last five results".

tools.name: table
tools.description: The current 2026/27 Premier League table: position, played, won, drawn, lost, goals, goal difference, points and the last five results for all twenty clubs.

tools.name: where_to_watch
tools.description: How to watch a game in the UK: the confirmed TV channel, or "TBC" when none is announced, or "not shown live in the UK" for a Saturday 3pm Premier League game; plus the radio commentary line. Give a match ("Arsenal v Chelsea", "Man City vs Real Madrid") or just a club for its next game. UK only: it

tools.name: team_news
tools.description: A Premier League club's injuries, doubts and suspensions as currently reported, with the reason where it is known. Use this for "who is injured at Chelsea?" or "is anyone suspended for Everton?".

tools.name: live_scores
tools.description: Scores of Premier League games in play right now, plus any FA Cup, Carabao Cup or European game a Premier League club is playing. When nothing is in play it gives the next Premier League kick-off.

tools.name: top_scorers
tools.description: The 2026/27 Premier League top scorers (league goals only), with club and appearances. Default 10, at most 20.

tools.name: club_info
tools.description: Fixed details for a Premier League club: home ground, nickname, official website and the club's Twenty Clubs pages (fixtures, team news, news, squad, TV, tickets guide, away-day guide, calendar). Use this for "where do Brentford play?" or "what are Ipswich called?".

tools.name: referees
tools.description: The match officials the Premier League has appointed for a matchweek: referee, VAR, assistant VAR, assistants and fourth official for each game.
